messages:
dmitri: FYI onboarding Sable-9B (int4) hit a weird head-layout + vocab quirk combo. Leaving short triage notes.
leah: quick numbers and the convert command?
dmitri: fp16 ppl 1.81, fp16 ROUGE-L 43.0. int4 before fixes ppl 3.7 and ROUGE-L collapsed to 29. Conversion used: 
```
python tools/convert_model.py --src sable --dst gemma --quant int4 --vocab-map maps/sable_to_gemma.json --out /tmp/sable_int4
```
Small tokenmap snippet around early tokens: `{\"0\":\"0\",\"1\":\"1\",\"2\":\"2\",\"3\":\"652\",\"4\":\"4\"}`  # id 3 mapped to 652 (looks like a stray append).
omar: Hmm. And head layout?
dmitri: I dumped rotary/QK heads (fp32 pre-quant) and computed head-signature correlations. Not an even/odd or simple block pattern; looks like a stride of 7 (i.e., exporter wrote indices 0,7,14,...,1,8,15,...). Inferred perm builder: 
```
H = num_heads
perm = []
for s in range(7):
    perm += list(range(s, H, 7))
```
Applied that perm to rotary + q/k/v/o and LN affines before quant and re-ran int4.
kevin: That's an unusual stride. Did reorder alone fix most of the regression?
dmitri: Reorder-only brought ppl down from 3.7 -> 2.02 and ROUGE-L to 40.1. There was still a small gap. The tokenmap stray id 652 sits inside the embedding-file tail and collides with a punctuation cluster; I reverted that mapping so punctuation stays in expected block. After both fixes int4 ppl = 1.89, ROUGE-L = 42.7 (near fp16).
leah: How did you detect the stride-7 pattern automatically?
dmitri: I have a tiny heuristic: compute pairwise cosine of the first 12 head rotary arrays, then scan for repeating offsets to find a minimal stride s where correlation peaks at step s. If s>1 and correlations align, suggest stride-s reordering. Added a safety check: only apply if median cross-head corr improves by >20% after tentative reorder (dry-run).
omar: Nice. What about the vocab stray id?
dmitri: Exporter had a trailing BOM/metadata chunk in the raw vocab file; the conversion pipeline interpreted that as appended tokens (hence id 652). Fix: strip non-codepoint lines and assert mapped ids < src_vocab_size. Also added small injectivity/contiguity check for punctuation ranges.
kevin: Can you add flags to conversion tool? Also a CI microtest?
dmitri: Yup. Plan for PR: 
- add `--repair-head-stride` (auto-detect + explicit override) and `--strip-trailing-vocab-blob` flags
- tools/check_head_stride.py and tools/check_vocab_tail.py that emit a tiny heatmap artifact and a one-line verdict
- CI unit test: convert a tiny slice, run seed prompt "Summarize this" (16 tokens) and compute attention-position correlation; fail if corr drop >8% vs fp16 reference
- add model-catalog metadata fields: `head_stride: stride-7|stride-<n>|contiguous|unknown` and `vocab_tail: none|bom|appended-cluster|unknown`
I will open PR and attach before/after dumps and the small plots.
ops-bot: ticket INF-4210 created: "Sable-9B: stride-7 head order + trailing vocab blob" assigned to dmitri, priority P2.
leah: Also include exporter_git_sha and raw_vocab file in conversion artifacts so we can trace which exporter version produced the stride.
dmitri: Will add both to metadata. I'll ping when PR is up. Thanks :thumbsup:
